game_concept: A action defense set in Mt. Pyre – Pyre Summit, the roaring summit: the volcanologist must handle fire sprites while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Compound Combo: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Pyre Summit: the roaring summit
core_gameplay_loop: In Pyre Summit, repeat each round: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly. Each round, fire sprites strike the obsidian gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the energy value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the obsidian gate from fire sprites in Pyre Summit: keep the energy meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 33-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: energy drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 33-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 2 (intro tier): Compound Combo
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Compound Combo' (Week 2 slot 12), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Pyre Summit'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how energy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against fire sprites in Pyre Summit.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 33 seconds while energy > 0.
